explanation: The forecast is too flat and misses the amplitude of regular seasonal swings. The red predicted line is consistently lower at the peaks and higher at the troughs, which is indicates an over-smoothing effect. The var_ratio is likely low, and the amplitude of the red line is visibly significantly smaller than the black line. The model is using lag features in LightGBM, which can lead to a way too much smoothing if seasonal features are period-specific. The suggested fixes are to add or strengthen seasonal features (day-of-week, Fourier terms) or reduce regularization. The metric to monitor is std(pred) / std(actual).
